Evidence: baseline assistant with tool_calls becomes candidate assistant with content "" and no tool_calls — tool calls dropped. Root cause likely AIMessage whose tool_calls live in `message.tool_calls` attribute, not additional_kwargs; code only reads additional_kwargs["tool_calls"], so tool calls dropped, and ToolMessage without matching tool_call_id → API error.

proposal.hypothesis: Tool calls attached to AIMessage.tool_calls (the standard LangChain attribute) are silently dropped during conversion because the converter only reads additional_kwargs['tool_calls']. The evidence shows an assistant message with two tool_calls reduced to bare content '' with no tool_calls, while the corresponding ToolMessage (tool_call_id='call_a') is preserved — producing an orphaned tool message the API rejects. Conversion likely succeeded (200) locally but the follow-up request fails, or validation fails with an empty assistant turn missing tool_calls.
repair_proposals: In convert_message_to_dict for AIMessage, read tool_calls from the message.tool_calls attribute (converted to OpenAI format via langchain_core.utils.function_calling.convert_to_openai_tool) in addition to additional_kwargs['tool_calls'], merging both sources so tool calls are never silently dropped.

Add a consistency guard: if any ToolMessage in the converted sequence references a tool_call_id not present on a preceding assistant message, raise a ValueError during conversion rather than emitting an invalid request.

Keep the existing content='' → None normalization for tool-call-only assistant messages, but ensure it applies also when tool_calls come from the attribute path so the evidence case yields {'role':'assistant','content':None,'tool_calls':[...]} exactly matching the baseline.

Add a regression test asserting that an AIMessage constructed with tool_calls=[ToolCall(...)] (standard constructor path, no additional_kwargs) converts to a dict containing equivalent tool_calls with ids 'call_a' and 'call_b' as in the evidence baseline.
Log a warning when additional_kwargs contains neither 'tool_calls' nor 'function_call' but message.tool_calls is non-empty and being forwarded, to aid diagnosis of dropped-call regressions.
